faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes, completely free. No sign-up, login, or app needed.
faq.q2: Are my files uploaded to a server?
faq.a2: No. Every conversion runs right in your browser, so your files never leave your device. That's also why it's fast and private.
faq.a3: Images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, GIF, BMP, ICO, SVG, TIFF, AVIF), video (MP4, WEBM, MOV, MKV, AVI, etc.), audio (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OPUS), documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML), spreadsheets (XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, TSV), data (JSON, YAML, XML), and ZIP archives. Any other file can still be compressed to ZIP or turned into Base64.
faq.q4: Why does video conversion take a while?
faq.a4: Video is processed by a conversion engine inside your browser, so the speed depends on your device. When only the container changes (for example MP4 to MKV) we copy the video stream without re-encoding, so it's almost instant.
faq.q5: How do I turn a PDF into images?
faq.a5: Choose a PDF file, then pick PNG or JPG. Every page becomes one image, and you can download them all at once as a ZIP.
faq.q6: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a6: Not from us. The only limit is your device's memory. For videos over 1–2 GB, a computer works best.
